title: Billing Disputes on PracticePay Patient Financing Treatment Charges
content:
A patient may dispute a provider's financed charge on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan — service not rendered, incorrect amount, refund not received or duplicate charge — by opening a billing dispute on that charge.

## Opening a dispute

A billing dispute can be opened only when the current date is no later than the purchase date plus the dispute window. The dispute window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the purchase date, and a dispute opened on the last day is in time. One dispute may be open per charge at a time.

| Dispute opened on (counting from the day after the purchase date, 60-day window) | In time |
|---|---|
| the 60th calendar day | yes |
| the 61st calendar day | no |

## While a dispute is open

While a dispute is open the disputed amount is left out of the amount past due for late fees and, on deferred-interest plans, out of the promotional payoff test; the patient still owes the undisputed monthly payment.

## Resolution

The provider resolves the dispute:

- **Provider credit.** A provider credit posts as a provider refund and fees caused by the disputed amount are waived on the dispute-resolved basis.
- **No error.** A no-error outcome makes the disputed amount payable again, and on a deferred-interest plan whose promotion ended during the dispute the patient keeps the promotion by paying the disputed amount within the post-dispute payment period.

A fee is waived on the dispute-resolved basis only for a billing dispute opened no later than the purchase date plus the dispute window; the purchase date is read from the plan and the opening date from the dispute record.

## Outside the process

Disputes about the quality of care that the provider will not credit are outside Larkspur's billing dispute process.

A dispute on Larkspur's records is open, resolved with a provider credit, resolved as no error, or withdrawn.
